mainEntity.name: Is basement flooring worth it, or should I just leave the concrete as-is?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you want a floor that lasts, the main objection is usually not the material cost but the prep cost. In basements, spending more on moisture control and proper installation usually prevents far more expensive repairs later, especially if the space has had leaks or dampness before.
